const dbData = $('Select rows from a table4').first().json;
const mergedServices = $input.all(); // Todos los items del merge

// Extraer todos los quotationVOs
const allQuotationVOs = mergedServices.map(item => item.json);

// Extraer todos los serviceIds
const allServiceIds = allQuotationVOs.map(q => q.serviceId);

// Armar el body completo
const body = {
  offeredServices: allServiceIds,
  iolmParts: [],
  recallVOs: [],
  campaignsId: [],
  country: "ARG",
  advisor: parseInt(dbData.advisorId),
  scheduleHour: parseInt(dbData.selected_hour),
  scheduleDate: dbData.selected_date,
  createUser: "b-kistn4",
  dealer: parseInt(dbData.sucursal),
  division: 1,
  vin: dbData.chassi,
  sendEmail: false,
  contactCountry: "ARG",
  vehiclePlate: dbData.plate,
  returned: "N",
  towTruckNeeded: "N",
  towTruckType: null,
  towingReason: null,
  customerRemark: null,
  advisorRemark: null,
  contactCustomerId: dbData.customerK,
  customerId: dbData.customerK,
  isDriverInformation: null,
  scheduleSource: "D",
  scheduleType: "R",
  model: "",
  group: parseInt(dbData.model_id),  // ✅ parseInt
  createS: new Date().toISOString().replace('Z', ''),  // ✅ Sin 'Z'
  quotationScheduleVO: {
    quotationVOs: allQuotationVOs
  },
  lastKm: null,
  oilLifeRemaining: null,
  iolmMonths: null,
  referredBy: 0
};

return [{ json: body }];
